archive.definition: Downloaded event records across the recovered guild archive, before deduplication and aggregation. This whole-archive count does not change with raid or year filters.

methodology.roster: At least 5 main-raid session appearances over at least 3 distinct Monday/Thursday nights, using the existing archive policy. Characters, not assumed unique people.
methodology.sessions: Through the final 1 April 2021 Australia/Sydney guild night: confirmed and inferred guild raids in MC, Onyxia, BWL, AQ40 and Naxxramas. Default view uses main nights, including manually classified reschedules. Pug and review records are excluded.
methodology.scope: Recovered history only. Missing logs do not establish absence. No death, loot or avoidable-damage awards are inferred.

deaths.reason: Player deaths are aggregated locally; hunter markers require lethal evidence.

sappers.reason: Goblin Sapper Charge cast events, counted once per activation.

coverage.failedPulls: Saved boss encounters with kill=false, including any wipe or reset recorded as a boss encounter. Reset and wipe cannot be distinguished from the saved summary. Unrecorded resets and missing reports are not counted.
